evidence_state: Acceptance evidence is generated from final frozen producer, raw-TLOG validator, and dual-contract bytes, isolated per-set clean builds, exact retained raw-root enumeration, record-level parsing, independently recomputed freshness, retained object/library/PDB bytes, complete input provenance, and same-set closure.
containing_commit_binding: This manifest is committed in its containing Git commit. The final containing hash is intentionally not embedded because doing so would be self-referential; an independent audit obtains the containing commit from Git and verifies its parent, subject, branch, scope, and hashes. Pre-final evidence does not claim generation from a commit that did not yet exist.
self_reference_limitation: Embedding the containing commit or requiring a Full guard transcript to validate its own final hash would be self-referential. Each Full guard run skips only its own changing transcript hash. Independent audit assigns the final containing commit and validates the final manifest and both Full-log hashes.
independent_audit_requirement: An independent audit must obtain the containing commit from Git and verify its parent, branch, production-source scope, manifest content, referenced hashes, retained input inventories, and final clean synchronized status.
historical_binary_limitation: All evidence generated before the schema-1.6 frozen producer run is historical. Acceptance relies only on the retained schema-1.6 four-set evidence under artifacts/logs/production-orchestration-ab-tlog-provenance/.

per_set_identity_verification_policy.mismatch_handling: Fail closed before accepting the set.
per_set_identity_verification_policy.independent_guard_recomputation: The Full guard recomputes the current producer and contract identities and compares every phase field.

independent_raw_tlog_parser_policy.requirements: Strict encoding detection, delimiter-aware splitting, record classification, calculated counters, and independent Full-guard reparse.

independent_freshness_recomputation_poli.authority: The Full guard recomputes from retained inventory timestamps and raw bytes; stored zero counters are not authority.

provenance_record_schemas.object_source_input: primary_source, project_local_headers, shared_repository_headers, external_headers, compiler command/read/write TLOGs, byte identity, project, configuration, and set
provenance_record_schemas.generated_library: separate command/read/write TLOGs, member objects, consuming operation/TLOGs, emission and consumption state, byte identity, configuration, and set
provenance_record_schemas.linked_library: classification, generated/external identity, producer and consumer operations/TLOGs, retained bytes when generated, configuration, and same-set identity
provenance_record_schemas.per_input: normalized and original path forms, repository/external classification, size, SHA-256, mechanisms, source TLOG references, consuming projects, tools, configuration, and set

git_state_semantics: GitClean is true only when short status is empty outside ignored roots and both ordinary and cached diff exit codes are zero. Intentional remediation changes are reported separately as clean relative to the frozen identity snapshot and are never labelled globally clean.
extra_tlog_negative_test_policy: A disposable copy of one canonical root receives one synthetic extra TLOG; exact-root validation must fail nonzero, restoration must pass with the original root hash, canonical root hash must remain unchanged, and the disposable tree is deleted.
pdb_retention_policy: Option A: all four retained PDB files are recorded in one mandatory manifest-hashed bidirectional inventory with byte identity, build/binary binding, ignored state, and untracked state.

ab_rebuild_contract.normalization_justification: A/B normalized equality is obtained only by zeroing linker timestamps, the derived PE checksum, debug-directory timestamps, and the per-build CodeView GUID. Executable-section bytes, imports, normalized disassembly, normalized symbols, retention boundaries, target/request absence, and Authenticode state are equal without exclusion.
ab_rebuild_contract.input_identity_method: Set-local retained raw TLOG closure for ChatpadFilter, ChatpadKmdfRequestOwnerContext, and complete ChatpadProtocol, plus retained object/library and same-set closure.

status_mapping.framework_status_rule: Returned only for the four creation-failure results and only when failing.

binary_inspection.rebuild_note: Set B is the final canonical candidate. A/B raw hashes differ, but only named nondeterministic metadata differs; normalized PE, executable sections, imports, disassembly, symbols, retention, target/request absence, and Authenticode state are equal.

provenance_closure_contract.retained_raw_root_policy: Each set has a disjoint raw-tlogs root enumerated independently in both directions.
provenance_closure_contract.strict_parser_contract: All raw bytes and record text are retained; encoding, delimiter, classification, and calculated counters are independently reparsed; unparseable, discarded, and unexplained counters must be zero.
provenance_closure_contract.generated_intermediate_retention_contrac: Every generated OBJ and LIB has a set-local byte copy and SHA-256.
provenance_closure_contract.source_input_closure_contract: Every retained OBJ has exactly one primary compile source, explicit project-local/shared-repository/external header classes, and retained CL command/read/write references.
provenance_closure_contract.generated_library_closure_contract: Every emitted project LIB is retained with separate command/read/write producer references; linked libraries are independently iterated; the declared but non-emitted ChatpadFilter import-library path is explicitly classified.
provenance_closure_contract.same_set_closure_contract: All producer, consumer, external-identity, contamination, and unexplained-output counters are zero.
provenance_closure_contract.transcript_schema: Every set transcript binds all four identity phases, honest global and frozen-relative Git state, clean/build/capture times, object/library/binary/PDB counts, and prohibited-action counters.
provenance_closure_contract.guard_defect_counter_schema: Full guards emit all provenance, evidence, parser, closure, transcript, and safety defect counters.
